summary: The diff implements most requirements well: a Motoko backend with 7 transport categories (REQ-1), a full frontend guide with filtering and cards (REQ-2), a tropical Hawaiian visual theme (REQ-3), and a hero banner referencing the generated image (REQ-4). However, the backend contains no pre-seeded data — it only defines the schema and CRUD operations, so the frontend will show an empty state unless data is added externally. The transport-icons image is not referenced anywhere in the frontend. The hero image path is referenced correctly in HeroBanner.tsx but there is no evidence the image file itself was generated/placed in frontend/public/assets/generated.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stores at least 7 transportation categories with pre-populated data queryable from the frontend
missing_requirements.reason: The backend defines the 7 category types and CRUD operations, but contains no initialization logic or pre-seeded entries. The frontend will display an empty state unless data is added manually after deployment, so the AC 'Backend stores at least 7 transportation categories' is not met at build time.

HeroBanner.tsx references /assets/generated/waikiki-hero.dim_1200x400.png but there is no evidence in the diff that the image file was generated or placed in frontend/public/assets/generated. No binary or asset file addition is listed.

hallucinated_features.description: Text search filtering of transportation entries
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention a text search feature — only a navigation or filtering mechanism to browse categories. The TransportationGuide page includes a full-text search input that filters by title, description, pricing, and tips.

hallucinated_features.description: Add and delete entry mutations exposed via useQueries hooks
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request is a read-only tourist guide. No requirement mentions the ability to add or delete entries from the frontend. The useAddEntry and useDeleteEntry mutation hooks are implemented.
